'''Lê Vũ Anh''' (1950 – 6 July 1981) was a Vietnamese mathematician and the daughter of former [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam]] [[Lê Duẩn]].

==Early life==
Lê Vũ Anh was born in 1950. She was the eldest daughter of Lê Duẩn and his second wife Nguyễn Thụy Nga. At the age of 4, she went with her mother to [[North Vietnam]] during [[Operation Passage to Freedom]] after signature of the [[1954 Geneva Conference|Geneva Accords]] in 1954, while her father stayed in the [[South Vietnam|South]] to participate in revolutionary activities.<ref name=":0">{{cite web |url=https://cand.com.vn/Phong-su-tu-lieu/Ve-cau-chuyen-tinh-cua-con-gai-Tong-Bi-thu-Le-Duan-voi-vien-si-khoa-hoc-Nga-i402073/|title=Về câu chuyện tình của con gái Tổng Bí thư Lê Duẩn với viện sĩ khoa học Nga |last=Lê|first= Kiên Thành|date=2016-08-26 |newspaper=cand.com.vn |access-date=26 August 2021}}</ref>

In 1959, Anh went to [[China]], where her mother studied journalism at [[Renmin University]]. In 1964, following their return to North Vietnam, Anh had to part with her mother after she decided to head to South Vietnam to participate in activities during the [[Vietnam War]]. Anh then lived with Lê Duẩn's uncle and younger brother. She was an excellent student in Vietnamese literature and was admitted to the [[Communist Party of Vietnam]] at 10th grade of her school.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://tienphong.vn/chuyen-ve-nguoi-vo-mien-nam-cua-co-tong-bi-thu-le-duan-ky-4-post53570.tpo|title=Chuyện về người vợ miền Nam của cố Tổng Bí thư Lê Duẩn - Kỳ 4|last=Xuân |first= Ba|date=2006-07-06 |newspaper=tienphong.vn |access-date=26 August 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://nguoivietodessa.com/chia-se-ban-doc/37111-hoi-ky-cua-vs-maslov-ve-moi-tinh-voi-le-vu-anh-phan-1.html|title=Hồi ký của VS Maslov về mối tình với Lê Vũ Anh (Phần 1)|last=Cao  |first= Kim Ánh|date=2016-08-23 |newspaper=nguoivietodessa.com|access-date=26 August 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://tuoitre.vn/phu-nhan-co-tong-bi-thu-le-duan-tu-tran-20181027113710914.htm|title=Phu nhân cố Tổng bí thư Lê Duẩn từ trần|last=|first= |date=2018-10-27 |newspaper=tuoitre.vn|access-date=26 August 2021}}</ref>

==Academic career==
After finishing school, Anh requested her father's permission to participate in the [[Vietnam War|war]]. Her request was denied by Lê Duẩn who urged her to complete her higher academic studies in order to contribute to the post-war development of the country.<ref name=":0"/>

In early 1970s, she went to [[Moscow]] where she studied [[mathematical physics]] at the Department of Physics in [[Lomonosov University]]. Along with her in the same department was Võ Hạnh Phúc, the daughter of General [[Võ Nguyên Giáp]]. Anh was passionate about mathematics and attended a seminar taught by a prominent Soviet mathematician Viktor Maslov (later, in 1984, elected to full membership in the Academy of Sciences of the USSR).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://vietnamnet.vn/vn/tuanvietnam/suyngam/nguoi-ban-dong-mon-le-vu-anh-con-gai-tbt-le-duan-trong-ky-uc-cua-toi-332891.html|title=Người bạn đồng môn Lê Vũ Anh con gái TBT Lê Duẩn trong ký ức của tôi|last=Nguyễn|first=Văn Cự|date=2016-10-08 |newspaper=vietnamnet.vn |access-date=26 August 2021}}</ref>

In 1975, one of her works was published in an international scientific journal even before mathematician [[Hoàng Xuân Sính]] who is considered the first female mathematician in Vietnam.<ref name="schroe">{{cite journal |url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2FBF01028957|title=Classical asymptotic behavior of the free Schrödinger equation for calculating corrections in the stationary phase method|last=Lê  |first=Vũ Anh|date=1975 |newspaper=link.springer.com |volume=25 |issue=2 |pages=1124–1127 |doi=10.1007/BF01028957 |bibcode=1975TMP....25.1124A |s2cid=123418236 |access-date=26 August 2021|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

In 1979, she defended her doctorate under the guidance of Maslov with a thesis titled ''Asymptotics of Multidimensional Phase Integrals'' ({{langx|ru|Асимптотика многомерных фазовых интегралов}}). Her other works on mathematical physics include:<ref>{{cite web |url=https://search.rsl.ru/ru/record/01009433007|title=Асимптотика многомерных фазовых интегралов : диссертация ... кандидата физик|last= |first=|date=1979|newspaper=search.rsl.ru |access-date=26 August 2021}}</ref>

*''On Fourier Integral Operators'', Mathematics of the USSR-Sbornik (1981), v. 38, 293–334.<ref>{{cite journal |url=http://dx.doi.org/10.1070/SM1981v038n03ABEH001332|title=On Fourier integral operators|date=1981|newspaper=mr.crossref.org|doi=10.1070/SM1981v038n03ABEH001332 |access-date=26 August 2021|last1=Danilov |first1=V. G. |last2=An' |first2=Le Vu |volume=38 |issue=3 |pages=293–334 |bibcode=1981SbMat..38..293D |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
*''Complex WKB Method for Calculating the Asymptotic Behavior of Phase Integrals'', Theoretical and Mathematical Physics (1976), v. 28, 787–791.<ref>{{cite journal |url=https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01029038|title=Complex WKB method for calculating the asymptotic behavior of phase integrals|date=1976|newspaper=link.springer.com|doi=10.1007/BF01029038 |access-date=26 August 2021|last1=Vu Le |first1=An' |volume=28 |issue=2 |pages=787–791 |bibcode=1976TMP....28..787L |s2cid=120862595 |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
*''Classical Asymptotic Behavior of the Free Schrödinger Equation for Calculating Corrections in the Stationary Phase Method'', Theoretical and Mathematical Physics (1975), v. 25, 1124–1127.<ref name="schroe"/>

==Personal life==
During her studies in Moscow, Anh had a love affair with her supervisor [[Viktor Maslov (mathematician)|Viktor Maslov]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Câu chuyện tình buồn bí mật của Lê Vũ Anh con gái ông Lê Duẩn lấy chồng người Nga|url=https://ttx.vanganh.org/2016/08/le-vu-anh-con-gai-ong-le-duan_17.html|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-07-29|website=www.ttx.vanganh.org}}</ref>

The romance was considered scandalous because Vietnamese students studying abroad were not allowed to have romantic relationships with foreigners and anyone caught red-handed would have to be examined or may be sent back to Vietnam. In order to avoid trouble, she returned home to marry a Vietnamese student from the same university and wanted to stay in Vietnam to forget her love affair with Maslov. However, she was forced by her father to return to [[USSR]] to complete her studies.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2016-08-26|title=Về câu chuyện tình của con gái Tổng Bí thư Lê Duẩn với viện sĩ khoa học Nga|url=http://cand.com.vn/Phong-su-tu-lieu/Ve-cau-chuyen-tinh-cua-con-gai-Tong-Bi-thu-Le-Duan-voi-vien-si-khoa-hoc-Nga-405658/|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-07-29|website=www.cand.com.vn}}</ref>

When she and her husband returned to Moscow, Anh realized that she did not love her husband and could not forget Maslov. She decided to live separately from her husband and secretly went back and forth with Maslov. Anh had enough courage to ask her husband for a divorce in order to be able to marry Maslov. In 1977, she and Maslov married. She gave birth to her daughter Lena on 31 October 1977. Meeting her father by chance when he went to USSR for a state visit, Anh confessed her love affair with Maslov. Lê Duẩn did not accept it and tried to lure her back to Vietnam. However, Anh gradually reconciled with her family. When Lê Duẩn went to Moscow, he saw his granddaughter Lena, but did not see Maslov.<ref name=":0"/>

In 1979, she gave birth to her second daughter Tania. After giving birth to her son Anton in 1981, Anh died shortly due to [[Postpartum bleeding|postpartum hemorrhage]]. Her body was cremated, and the ashes were brought back to Vietnam.<ref name=":0"/>

In 1989, Maslov used the pseudonym 'O. Martínov' to publish his autobiography, where he discusses his love affair with Lê Vũ Anh.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|title=Lê Vũ Anh, con gái ông Lê Duẩn, bị đầu độc? (1)|url=http://vietinfo.eu/nhan-vat/le-vu-anh-con-gai-ong-le-duan-bi-dau-doc-1.html|date=2016-08-17|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-07-29|website=www.vietinfo.eu}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://7days.ru/caravan-collection/2015/6/viktor-maslov-chtoby-otvoevat-detey-ya-byl-gotov-na-vse-dazhe-na-mezhdunarodnyy-skandal/19.htm|title=Виктор Маслов: "Чтобы отвоевать детей, я был готов на все, даже на международный скандал"|last=|first= |date=2015-06-11 |newspaper=7days.ru |access-date=26 August 2021}}</ref>
